card.name: Multiplication inside dosing formulas
card.fires_on: Multiplication signs and the opening bracket or digit right after them in kidney-function and dose formulas, such as Cockcroft-Gault, MDRD and Calvert. Also digits within the numbers being multiplied.

modes.label: Bracket after multiply sign
modes.description: An opening parenthesis right after x or × in a clearance or dosing formula.

modes.label: Digits in formula numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a constant or number being multiplied in a formula or dose line.

card.plain: It fires in math formulas where numbers are multiplied, like kidney clearance and carboplatin dose calculations.
